entries.title: Your last messages above the message box are easier to read on iPhone and iPad
entries.body: On iPhone and iPad, your last messages and your first mate's replies above the message box are larger, one step under the words you type. Your message sits in a bubble that fits its words, and each reply is in a softer colour, so the rows read as a quick glance under the card. You can tap anywhere along a reply's row to open the whole reply.

picture.alt: On iPhone, your message in a grey bubble on the right above the message box and the first mate's reply in a softer colour beside its mark
